!VTAPconfig

; All eleven keyboard settings. KBDelayMS=2 is below the documented
; minimum of 5 and appears in the manufacturer's own sample file, so
; parsing preserves it rather than rejecting or clamping it.
KBLogMode=1
KBEnable=1
KBSource=81
KBPrefix=%09
KBPostfix=%0D
KBDelayMS=2
KBPassMode=1
KBPassSection=2
KBPassSeparator=;
KBPassStart=3
KBPassLength=14
